# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Verified that the branch already contains the approved tanksim-6e5.6.3 molt/mineral fixes, so this apply-fixes pass was validation-only and required no additional source edits. I rechecked the relevant shrimp runtime/species wiring and reran focused and broad regression coverage; current HEAD passes the full `tank_core` suite plus downstream `tank_data` and `tank_scenarios` tests.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspected the current worktree and the relevant shrimp molt/mineral parameter, diagnostic, and regression paths to confirm there were no remaining review-requested fixes to apply on this branch.
2. [Completed] Reran focused regressions for molt/mineral behavior, validation, save/load, and reproduction-factor coverage, along with downstream `tank_data` and `tank_scenarios` suites.
3. [Completed] Ran the full `tank_core` test suite to confirm broader stability and recorded this stage as validation-only because no new code changes were needed.

## Validation Evidence

- `git status --short`
- `git diff -- crates/tank_core/tests/reproduction_factors.rs`
- `rg -n "temp_condition_low_divisor_c|temp_condition_high_divisor_c|test_soft_vs_hard_water_shrimp_survival|MarginalFailure|critical_molt_gh_ratio" crates/tank_core crates/tank_data crates/tank_scenarios`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test molt_mineral_budget -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test validation -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test save_load -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test reproduction_factors -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_data -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_scenarios -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core -- --nocapture`

## Outstanding Risks

None identified.
